# Business Rules Specification for E-commerce Shopping Mall Platform

## 1. Core Business Rules and Logic

### 1.1 Platform Operation Fundamentals

#### Business Entity Management Rules
THE platform SHALL maintain strict referential integrity across all business entities including customers, products, orders, payments, and inventory records.

WHEN a customer account is deleted, THE system SHALL automatically archive all associated order history and prevent new orders while maintaining data for financial and legal compliance requirements.

THE platform SHALL enforce unique identifiers for all business entities: customer IDs, product SKUs, order numbers, and transaction IDs SHALL be globally unique within the system.

THE system SHALL maintain complete audit trails for all business-critical operations including customer modifications, product changes, order status updates, and administrative actions.

#### Business State Management Rules
EVERY business entity SHALL have defined states with specific allowed transitions according to business workflow requirements.

THE platform SHALL prevent backward state transitions unless specifically authorized by administrative override with full audit trail documentation.

WHEN business entities reach terminal states (completed orders, archived customers, discontinued products), THE system SHALL restrict modifications while preserving read-only access for historical reporting.

### 1.2 Inter-Entity Relationship Constraints

#### Customer-Product Relationship Rules
THE platform SHALL prevent customers from purchasing products that are out of stock, discontinued, or restricted based on customer tier or geographic location.

WHEN a product becomes unavailable during checkout, THE system SHALL automatically remove the item from the customer's cart and notify the customer of the unavailability.

CUSTOMERS SHALL be restricted from purchasing products outside their permitted categories based on their account type, age verification, or regional compliance requirements.

THE system SHALL apply customer-specific pricing tiers and discounts automatically based on customer classification and purchase history.

#### Order-Payment-Product Integration Rules
EVERY order SHALL contain valid product SKUs with confirmed inventory availability at the time of order placement.

THE platform SHALL prevent order completion without corresponding successful payment authorization or approved alternative payment arrangements.

WHEN partial order fulfillment occurs, THE system SHALL automatically adjust inventory, update order status, and manage customer communication regarding fulfillment status.

THE platform SHALL maintain real-time synchronization between order status, inventory levels, and payment processing throughout the entire order lifecycle.

## 2. Validation Rules and Constraints

### 2.1 Customer Data Validation Rules

#### Account Creation and Maintenance Validation
WHEN customers register accounts, THE system SHALL validate email address format using RFC 5322 standards, password complexity requiring minimum 8 characters with uppercase, lowercase, number, and special character requirements before account activation.

CUSTOMER email addresses SHALL be unique across the platform with verification required before account activation and password recovery functionality activation.

THE system SHALL validate customer addresses using address verification services with real-time validation against postal databases and prevent orders to unverified or invalid delivery addresses.

CUSTOMER profiles SHALL include mandatory information: full name, primary contact number, delivery address, and marketing communication preferences before enabling full platform functionality.

#### Customer Communication Validation
EMAIL notifications SHALL be sent to customer-provided addresses only after email verification completion and customer opt-in consent with unsubscribe functionality included.

SMS notifications SHALL be sent to verified phone numbers with customer consent for order updates, delivery notifications, and promotional communications with opt-out mechanisms.

THE platform SHALL prevent communication to customers who have opted out of specific communication types while maintaining essential order-related notifications.

### 2.2 Product Information Validation Rules

#### Product Catalog Data Requirements
EVERY product SHALL include mandatory information: product name, description, SKU, category, pricing, inventory quantity, weight, dimensions, and image assets before public availability.

PRODUCT SKUs SHALL be unique, alphanumeric, between 5-15 characters, and cannot be reused even if original products are discontinued or deleted.

THE platform SHALL validate product pricing against minimum/maximum thresholds of $0.01 to $999,999.99 and require administrative approval for pricing outside established ranges.

PRODUCT categories SHALL follow defined taxonomy with parent-child relationships enforced to maintain organized product structure with maximum depth of 4 levels.

#### Product Image and Content Validation
PRODUCT images SHALL meet minimum resolution requirements of 800x600 pixels, appropriate aspect ratios of 1:1 to 16:9, and content guidelines before product publication.

THE system SHALL validate product descriptions for prohibited content, accurate specifications, and compliance with advertising regulations with automated content filtering.

PRODUCT variations SHALL maintain consistent pricing structure and cannot have conflicting specifications within the same product family.

### 2.3 Order and Transaction Validation Rules

#### Order Placement Validation Requirements
CUSTOMERS SHALL have active, verified accounts with valid payment methods before order placement authorization.

THE platform SHALL validate shipping addresses against delivery service coverage areas and require customer confirmation for deliveries outside standard service areas.

ORDERS SHALL be validated for minimum order values of $10.00, maximum item quantities of 50 units per SKU, and product availability before payment processing initiation.

THE system SHALL prevent duplicate orders by implementing order ID tracking and customer purchase history validation with 30-minute duplicate prevention windows.

#### Payment Transaction Validation Logic
PAYMENT methods SHALL be validated for expiration dates, available balances, and authorization limits before transaction processing with real-time verification.

THE platform SHALL implement fraud detection algorithms using machine learning models and require additional verification for transactions exceeding $500 or showing suspicious ordering patterns.

TRANSACTIONS SHALL be validated against customer's purchasing limits, daily spending caps of $2,000, and geographic restrictions based on customer profile and risk assessment.

WHEN payment validation fails, THE system SHALL provide specific error codes and recommendations for resolution while preventing order placement.

## 3. Business Process Automation Rules

### 3.1 Automated Workflow Triggers

#### Order Processing Automation
WHEN customer orders are placed and payment authorized, THE system SHALL automatically allocate inventory within 2 minutes, generate picking lists, and assign orders to fulfillment queues.

THE platform SHALL automatically send order confirmation emails with order details and tracking information, update customer order history, and trigger inventory reduction within 5 minutes of successful payment processing.

WHEN orders reach fulfillment readiness, THE system SHALL automatically generate shipping labels using carrier APIs, notify delivery partners, and update order status to "shipped" with tracking number generation.

THE platform SHALL automatically process returns and refunds according to policy rules when return requests are submitted within eligible timeframes of 30 days from delivery.

#### Inventory Management Automation
WHEN product inventory reaches reorder points defined as 20% of maximum stock levels, THE system SHALL automatically generate purchase orders, notify suppliers, and update stock status to "on order".

THE platform SHALL automatically adjust inventory levels for returned items, damaged goods, and quality control write-offs within 24 hours with full audit trail documentation.

WHEN stock levels fall below safety thresholds of 10% of maximum inventory, THE system SHALL automatically restrict product visibility on public catalog and notify inventory management teams via automated alerts.

### 3.2 Customer Communication Automation

#### Event-Driven Communication Triggers
WHEN orders change status, THE system SHALL automatically send appropriate notifications to customers with relevant tracking information and expected delivery dates within 15 minutes of status change.

THE platform SHALL automatically send post-purchase follow-up emails requesting reviews and ratings for products within 7 days of confirmed delivery with automated review request scheduling.

WHEN customer accounts show unusual activity patterns including rapid successive purchases or geo-location changes, THE system SHALL automatically trigger security alerts and require additional authentication verification.

THE platform SHALL automatically send abandoned cart recovery emails to customers who leave items in cart for more than 24 hours with personalized product recommendations.

#### Scheduled Business Operations
THE platform SHALL automatically run daily inventory reconciliation at 2:00 AM, identify discrepancies, and generate reports for management review by 6:00 AM daily.

THE system SHALL automatically process monthly customer tier evaluations and apply corresponding benefits and restrictions within the first week of each month.

THE platform SHALL automatically generate daily sales reports at midnight, weekly performance summaries every Monday at 8:00 AM, and monthly business analytics for stakeholder distribution.

## 4. Pricing and Discount Rules

### 4.1 Base Pricing Structure Rules

#### Standard Pricing Logic
PRODUCTS SHALL have defined base prices with automatic currency conversion for international customers using real-time exchange rates updated every 4 hours.

THE platform SHALL apply regional pricing adjustments based on customer location, tax requirements, and local market conditions with full pricing transparency displayed to customers.

CUSTOMERS in different geographic regions SHALL receive appropriate pricing with tax calculations, import duties, and shipping cost adjustments included with detailed cost breakdown.

THE system SHALL maintain price history tracking for all products and implement automatic price adjustment notifications for significant price changes exceeding 10% within 30 days.

#### Volume Pricing and Bulk Order Rules
CUSTOMERS purchasing quantities exceeding 10 units SHALL receive automatic volume discounts based on predefined quantity breakpoints: 10-24 units (5% discount), 25-49 units (10% discount), 50+ units (15% discount).

WHEN customers exceed bulk purchase thresholds, THE system SHALL automatically apply tiered pricing without manual intervention or customer negotiation with transparent discount calculation display.

THE platform SHALL prevent customers from splitting large orders across multiple transactions to circumvent volume discount thresholds by implementing customer purchase pattern analysis.

### 4.2 Promotional Pricing and Discount Rules

#### Discount Application Hierarchy
PROMOTIONAL discounts SHALL follow specific hierarchy: coupon codes apply first, then bulk discounts, then loyalty program benefits, and finally seasonal promotions with automatic optimization.

THE system SHALL prevent discount stacking beyond maximum allowable discount percentages of 50% per order and prevent combination of incompatible promotional offers.

CUSTOMER loyalty program benefits SHALL automatically apply at checkout without manual code entry and SHALL be clearly displayed before order completion with point balance information.

WHEN multiple discounts are applicable, THE system SHALL automatically select the most beneficial discount combination for customers with full transparency in savings breakdown.

#### Promotional Campaign Management Rules
PROMOTIONAL campaigns SHALL have defined start/end dates with automatic activation and deactivation based on scheduled campaign timelines with 24-hour advance notification.

THE platform SHALL restrict promotional offers to eligible customer segments and geographic regions as defined in campaign parameters with automatic customer eligibility verification.

PROMOTIONAL codes SHALL have usage limits per customer (maximum 3 uses), maximum discount amounts of $500, and expiration dates with automatic validation during checkout.

THE system SHALL track promotional code usage and prevent duplicate redemptions while maintaining complete promotional campaign analytics with real-time performance monitoring.

## 5. Inventory and Stock Management Rules

### 5.1 Stock Level Management Rules

#### Inventory Tracking Requirements
THE platform SHALL maintain real-time inventory levels with automatic updates for all stock movements including sales, returns, adjustments, and transfers within 30 seconds of activity.

INVENTORY tracking SHALL include product variants, locations, batch numbers, and expiration dates where applicable with full audit trail maintenance and 7-year retention periods.

WHEN inventory discrepancies are detected exceeding 2% variance from expected levels, THE system SHALL automatically flag affected products, restrict sales, and notify inventory management teams within 1 hour.

THE platform SHALL implement inventory reconciliation processes with physical inventory counts at least monthly with variance reporting and correction procedures including root cause analysis.

#### Stock Allocation and Reservation Logic
ORDERS SHALL automatically reserve inventory at order placement to prevent overselling during the payment processing period with 30-minute reservation windows.

THE platform SHALL release unconfirmed inventory reservations after 30 minutes of order placement if payment is not completed with customer notification.

WHEN customers modify orders, THE system SHALL automatically adjust inventory allocations and notify fulfillment teams of changes within 5 minutes of modification.

THE platform SHALL prevent negative inventory levels and require administrative override for stock adjustments below zero with full audit trail documentation.

### 5.2 Inventory Quality and Condition Management

#### Product Quality Control Rules
RECEIVED inventory SHALL undergo quality inspection with automated approval for products meeting specifications and automatic rejection for non-conforming items within 24 hours.

THE system SHALL maintain product condition tracking including new, used, refurbished, and damaged classifications with appropriate pricing adjustments and condition-based availability rules.

WHEN products are damaged during handling or storage, THE system SHALL automatically adjust inventory status and generate replacement or refund processes within 48 hours of damage identification.

THE platform SHALL implement product recall management with automatic removal from sale and customer notification for recalled items within 2 hours of recall notice.

#### Multi-Location Inventory Management Rules
THE platform SHALL maintain separate inventory tracking for each warehouse location with automatic allocation based on delivery proximity and stock availability using optimization algorithms.

WHEN fulfilling orders from multiple locations, THE system SHALL optimize shipping costs and delivery times while maintaining accurate inventory records with automatic cost calculation.

THE platform SHALL implement inventory transfer procedures between locations with automatic status updates and shipping cost calculations with 24-48 hour transfer timeframes.

## 6. Order Processing Rules

### 6.1 Order Lifecycle Management Rules

#### Order Status Progression Logic
ORDERS SHALL progress through defined statuses: pending payment, payment processing, confirmed, picking, packed, shipped, delivered, and completed with automatic transitions based on business rules.

THE platform SHALL prevent skipping order status transitions and SHALL require administrative approval for status corrections with full audit documentation including approval justification.

WHEN orders reach completion, THE system SHALL automatically finalize all related transactions, update customer purchase history, and enable review submission within 24 hours of delivery confirmation.

THE platform SHALL maintain order status change history with timestamps, responsible parties, and reason codes for complete audit trail with 7-year retention periods.

#### Order Modification and Cancellation Rules
CUSTOMERS SHALL be allowed to modify orders within 30 minutes of placement or until status changes to "confirmed" without administrative approval with automatic recalculation.

ORDERS CANCELLED by customers SHALL automatically trigger refund processing, inventory release, and cancellation confirmation within 24 hours with detailed cancellation reason tracking.

THE system SHALL prevent modifications to orders in advanced fulfillment stages and SHALL require administrative approval for post-confirmation changes with customer notification.

WHEN customers request order modifications, THE platform SHALL automatically recalculate pricing, taxes, shipping costs, and delivery dates with customer approval required before processing.

### 6.2 Order Fulfillment and Delivery Rules

#### Fulfillment Process Requirements
ORDERS SHALL be fulfilled using FIFO (First In, First Out) methodology to ensure timely processing and minimize inventory aging with automatic queue prioritization.

THE system SHALL automatically assign orders to fulfillment teams based on complexity, priority, and workload balancing requirements with performance tracking.

WHEN inventory is insufficient for order fulfillment, THE platform SHALL automatically offer partial fulfillment options or order splitting with customer notification and approval requirements.

THE platform SHALL implement quality control checkpoints throughout fulfillment process with automatic status updates and exception handling with 99.5% accuracy requirements.

#### Delivery and Shipping Rules
CUSTOMERS SHALL be provided with multiple shipping options with automatic cost calculation, delivery time estimates, and tracking number generation using carrier integration APIs.

THE platform SHALL automatically update tracking information and notify customers of delivery status changes including pickup, transit, and delivery attempts with real-time updates.

WHEN deliveries fail, THE system SHALL automatically attempt redelivery and notify customers of delivery issues with options for pickup or alternative arrangements within 24 hours.

THE platform SHALL implement delivery confirmation requirements including signature verification for orders exceeding $500 and photo proof for packages exceeding $100 value.

## 7. Customer Eligibility and Qualification Rules

### 7.1 Account Verification and Validation Requirements

#### Account Status Management Rules
CUSTOMER accounts SHALL be verified through email confirmation, phone number validation, and address verification before full platform access is granted with 72-hour verification windows.

THE system SHALL automatically suspend accounts showing suspicious activity patterns including multiple failed payment attempts and require additional verification before reactivation.

CUSTOMER accounts with negative purchase history including chargebacks exceeding $1,000 or 3+ chargebacks within 12 months SHALL be flagged for manual review and may have purchasing restrictions applied.

THE platform SHALL implement automatic account closure for inactive accounts after 24 months of no activity with data retention for legal compliance and customer notification 90 days prior.

#### Customer Tier and Classification Logic
CUSTOMER tiers SHALL be automatically calculated based on purchase frequency (minimum 2 purchases per month), total spending (Bronze: $0-499, Silver: $500-1,999, Gold: $2,000-4,999, Platinum: $5,000+), and account tenure with automatic tier upgrades when criteria are met.

THE system SHALL apply tier-specific benefits including discounts (Bronze: 0%, Silver: 2%, Gold: 5%, Platinum: 10%), shipping preferences (free shipping for Gold+), and customer service priority based on current tier classification.

CUSTOMERS SHALL retain tier status for minimum periods of 6 months with automatic tier evaluations monthly to prevent frequent tier fluctuations.

THE platform SHALL implement tier probation periods for customers who downgrade spending patterns with benefit adjustments after probation completion and customer notification.

### 7.2 Purchase Eligibility and Qualification Rules

#### Geographic and Regulatory Compliance Rules
CUSTOMERS SHALL be restricted from purchasing restricted products based on their geographic location and local regulations with automatic geographic validation using IP geolocation and address verification.

THE platform SHALL validate customer age for age-restricted products including alcohol (21+), tobacco (18+), and require additional verification for customers purchasing regulated items.

CUSTOMERS located in high-risk geographic regions SHALL be subject to additional verification requirements and transaction monitoring with enhanced due diligence procedures.

THE system SHALL implement export control compliance rules for international orders with automatic screening against restricted party lists and OFAC compliance verification.

#### Credit and Financial Qualification Rules
CUSTOMERS using credit payment methods SHALL be subject to credit approval processes with automatic credit limit assignments based on risk assessment algorithms considering payment history, account age, and purchase patterns.

THE platform SHALL implement spending limits for new customers with gradual limit increases based on positive payment history: initial limit $500, increasing $250 every 6 months with good payment history.

WHEN customers exceed credit limits or show payment difficulties, THE system SHALL automatically restrict additional purchases until payments are current with customer notification and payment plan options.

THE platform SHALL implement automatic credit limit reviews quarterly with adjustments based on payment history and account behavior patterns using machine learning models.

## 8. Compliance and Regulatory Requirements

### 8.1 Data Protection and Privacy Compliance Rules

#### GDPR and Privacy Regulation Compliance
THE platform SHALL implement explicit consent mechanisms for all data collection activities with clear opt-in/opt-out options for marketing communications and granular consent controls.

CUSTOMERS SHALL have the right to access, modify, or delete their personal data with automated data portability features and response timelines within 30 days of request submission.

THE system SHALL maintain data retention policies with automatic data deletion for customers who exercise their right to be forgotten within required timeframes of 30 days of verification.

THE platform SHALL implement privacy-by-design principles with data minimization, purpose limitation, and storage limitation throughout all business processes with regular privacy impact assessments.

#### Data Security and Protection Rules
CUSTOMER financial data SHALL be encrypted using AES-256 encryption methods with secure key management using hardware security modules and regular security audits quarterly.

THE system SHALL implement access controls with role-based permissions, multi-factor authentication for administrative access, and complete audit logging with 7-year retention.

CUSTOMER data SHALL be protected against unauthorized access with intrusion detection systems, automated threat response, and security incident notification procedures within 1 hour.

THE platform SHALL implement data backup and recovery procedures with encrypted backups, regular testing monthly, and disaster recovery planning with 4-hour recovery time objectives.

### 8.2 Financial and Tax Compliance Rules

#### Tax Calculation and Remittance Requirements
THE platform SHALL automatically calculate and collect applicable sales taxes, VAT, and other required taxes based on customer location and product categories with real-time tax rate updates.

WHEN customers are exempt from certain taxes, THE system SHALL validate exemption certificates and apply appropriate tax treatments with documentation requirements and annual certificate renewals.

TAX collection SHALL be maintained in segregated accounts with automated remittance to appropriate tax authorities based on jurisdiction requirements with monthly reconciliation.

THE platform SHALL generate tax reporting documentation including sales tax reports, 1099 forms for sellers, and annual tax summaries for customers with automated generation and distribution.

#### Financial Reporting and Record Keeping Rules
THE platform SHALL maintain complete financial transaction records including all sales, refunds, chargebacks, and fee calculations with 7-year retention periods and automated daily backups.

FINANCIAL reconciliation SHALL be performed daily with automated variance detection and manual review for significant discrepancies exceeding $100 within 24 hours.

THE system SHALL implement anti-money laundering (AML) procedures with customer due diligence, transaction monitoring using AI algorithms, and suspicious activity reporting to FinCEN.

## 9. Business Exception Handling Rules

### 9.1 Error Handling and Recovery Procedures

#### System Error Response Rules
WHEN business rule violations occur, THE system SHALL provide specific error messages with clear recovery instructions and escalation paths for complex issues within 15 minutes of detection.

THE platform SHALL implement automatic retry mechanisms for transient system failures with exponential backoff starting at 1 second, maximum 5 retries, and circuit breaker patterns.

WHEN manual intervention is required, THE system SHALL automatically create support tickets with complete context information and assign to appropriate teams based on issue categorization.

THE platform SHALL maintain business continuity plans with offline processing capabilities and graceful degradation for non-critical system failures ensuring 99.9% uptime.

#### Business Rule Violation Handling Logic
WHEN customers attempt actions violating business rules, THE system SHALL block the action, provide clear explanations with specific violation details, and suggest alternative compliant actions.

ADMINISTRATIVE overrides SHALL require dual approval for significant business rule exceptions with full audit trails and justification documentation with 72-hour approval timeframes.

THE platform SHALL implement business rule monitoring with automatic alerts for rule violations and trend analysis for process improvement opportunities using machine learning.

### 9.2 Emergency and Manual Intervention Procedures

#### Emergency Response and Escalation Rules
WHEN system failures affect order processing, THE platform SHALL automatically implement manual order processing procedures with priority handling for critical orders and 4-hour maximum processing timeframes.

BUSINESS-critical operations SHALL have manual backup procedures with designated personnel responsible for emergency process execution including 24/7 on-call rotations.

THE platform SHALL implement communication procedures for major system issues including customer notification, stakeholder updates, and resolution timelines with regular status updates.

WHEN manual interventions are performed, THE system SHALL capture all actions in comprehensive audit logs with supervisor review and approval requirements within 24 hours.

#### Exception Resolution and Process Improvement Rules
BUSINESS exceptions SHALL be categorized and analyzed for root causes with automated process improvements where applicable and manual review for complex exceptions using Six Sigma methodologies.

THE platform SHALL implement learning systems that automatically adjust business rules based on exception patterns and resolution effectiveness with monthly rule optimization reviews.

REGULAR business rule reviews SHALL be conducted quarterly with stakeholders to ensure rules remain current with business needs and regulatory requirements.

WHEN business rule changes are implemented, THE system SHALL automatically update all related processes and communicate changes to affected stakeholders with 30-day implementation windows.

---

*This comprehensive business rules specification provides the foundation for all platform operations, ensuring consistent business logic application, regulatory compliance, and exceptional customer experience throughout the e-commerce shopping mall platform. All rules are designed to be implementation-ready with specific thresholds, timeframes, and measurable criteria for backend development teams.*

# E-Commerce Shopping Mall Platform - Requirements Specification

## Project Overview

### Vision Statement
The E-Commerce Shopping Mall Platform is designed to provide a comprehensive, scalable, and user-friendly online shopping experience that rivals traditional retail outlets while offering the convenience of digital commerce. This platform will serve as a complete ecosystem supporting merchants, customers, and administrators through modern web technologies and intuitive interfaces.

### Platform Objectives
- **Customer Experience**: Deliver seamless shopping experiences across multiple devices with fast loading times and intuitive navigation
- **Merchant Support**: Provide comprehensive tools for inventory management, order processing, and customer engagement
- **Administrative Control**: Enable efficient platform management through powerful admin interfaces and analytics
- **Scalability**: Support growing user bases and increasing transaction volumes through robust architecture
- **Security**: Implement industry-standard security measures to protect user data and financial transactions

## Core Business Requirements

### 1. Product Catalog Management

#### 1.1 Product Information Management
WHEN merchants add new products to their catalog, THE system SHALL capture and manage comprehensive product information including title, description, specifications, images, pricing, and availability status.

**Product Data Requirements:**
- Product titles and descriptions must be SEO-optimized for search visibility
- Product images must support multiple formats (JPG, PNG, WebP) with automatic resizing
- Specification fields must be configurable per product category
- Pricing information must support base price, promotional pricing, and bulk pricing tiers
- Inventory tracking must maintain real-time stock levels across all warehouse locations

#### 1.2 Category and Taxonomy Management
WHEN customers browse products, THE system SHALL organize products into hierarchical categories that allow intuitive navigation and efficient product discovery.

**Category Structure Requirements:**
- Support for multi-level category hierarchies (up to 5 levels deep)
- Category-specific attribute sets for enhanced filtering
- Cross-category product classification for multi-faceted products
- Dynamic category promotions and featured product placement
- Category-based search optimization and relevance scoring

#### 1.3 Product Variations and Bundles
WHEN customers purchase products with options, THE system SHALL manage product variations and bundles through structured variant relationships.

**Variation Management Requirements:**
- Support for size, color, material, and custom attribute variations
- Variant-specific pricing, inventory, and image management
- Bundle creation with percentage or fixed discount pricing
- Cross-sell and up-sell recommendations based on variation combinations
- Variant inventory synchronization across all销售渠道

### 2. Shopping Cart and Checkout Process

#### 2.1 Shopping Cart Operations
WHEN customers add items to their shopping cart, THE system SHALL maintain persistent cart state across all user sessions and devices.

**Cart Functionality Requirements:**
- Persistent cart storage for registered users across all devices
- Guest cart functionality with expiration for non-registered users
- Real-time cart total calculations including shipping, taxes, and discounts
- Cart abandonment recovery through automated email campaigns
- Integration with wishlist functionality for future purchase planning

#### 2.2 Checkout Process Workflow
WHEN customers proceed to checkout, THE system SHALL guide them through a streamlined process that minimizes friction and maximizes conversion rates.

**Checkout Workflow Requirements:**
- Multi-step checkout process with progress indicators and error validation
- Guest checkout option for one-time purchasers with optional account creation
- Address validation and shipping option integration
- Multiple payment method support including credit cards, digital wallets, and buy-now-pay-later services
- Order review and confirmation with detailed breakdown of costs and delivery information

#### 2.3 Cart Validation and Business Rules
WHEN customers attempt to complete purchases, THE system SHALL enforce business rules that ensure valid transactions and inventory availability.

**Cart Validation Requirements:**
- Real-time inventory verification during checkout process
- Minimum order value enforcement for promotional eligibility
- Maximum quantity limits per product based on inventory and business policies
- Shipping zone validation for address-specific delivery options
- Payment authorization verification before order confirmation

### 3. Order Management System

#### 3.1 Order Processing Workflow
WHEN customers place orders, THE system SHALL automatically process orders through defined workflow stages from confirmation to fulfillment.

**Order Processing Stages:**
- Order placement confirmation with immediate customer notification
- Inventory reservation and order validation
- Payment processing and authorization
- Order fulfillment with tracking information generation
- Delivery confirmation and order completion

#### 3.2 Order Status Management
WHEN orders progress through fulfillment stages, THE system SHALL maintain accurate status information and provide real-time updates to customers.

**Order Status Tracking Requirements:**
- Granular order status tracking including payment, fulfillment, and delivery stages
- Automated status notifications via email and SMS
- Order status dashboards for customers and administrators
- Historical order archive with search and filter capabilities
- Integration with shipping carriers for automated status updates

#### 3.3 Order Modification and Cancellation
WHEN customers request changes to pending orders, THE system SHALL accommodate reasonable modifications within business-defined timeframes.

**Order Modification Capabilities:**
- Address changes for pending orders within fulfillment cutoff times
- Product quantity adjustments based on inventory availability
- Order cancellation requests with automated refund processing
- Partial cancellation support for multi-item orders
- Modification history tracking and audit trail maintenance

### 4. Inventory Management System

#### 4.1 Real-time Inventory Tracking
WHEN products are sold or restocked, THE system SHALL maintain accurate inventory levels across all warehouse locations and sales channels.

**Inventory Tracking Requirements:**
- Real-time inventory synchronization across all inventory sources
- Multi-location inventory management with transfer capabilities
- Low stock alerts and automatic reorder point notifications
- Inventory valuation methods including FIFO, LIFO, and weighted average
- Inventory aging analysis and clearance management

#### 4.2 Stock Management Operations
WHEN inventory levels change due to sales, returns, or adjustments, THE system SHALL update inventory records and trigger appropriate business processes.

**Stock Management Functions:**
- Automatic stock deduction upon order placement
- Return merchandise authorization with inventory restocking
- Inventory adjustments with reason code tracking
- Vendor purchase order integration with incoming stock notifications
- Cycle counting and physical inventory reconciliation processes

#### 4.3 Inventory Analytics and Forecasting
WHEN administrators need inventory insights, THE system SHALL provide analytics and forecasting tools to optimize inventory levels and reduce carrying costs.

**Inventory Analytics Requirements:**
- Sales velocity analysis and product performance metrics
- Seasonal demand forecasting based on historical data
- Safety stock calculations and reorder point optimization

### 5. User Account Management

- Social media authentication integration (Google, Facebook, Apple)

#### 5.2 User Preferences and Personalization

#### 5.3 Account Security and Privacy

- Session management with automatic logout and suspicious activity detection
- Data encryption for all sensitive personal and financial information

### 6. Administrative Panel Requirements

#### 6.1 Administrative Dashboard Overview

**Dashboard Components:**

- Order volume and processing status overview

#### 6.2 User Management Operations
WHEN administrators manage user accounts, THE system SHALL provide comprehensive tools for user account administration and support.

**User Management Functions:**

#### 6.3 Product and Catalog Administration

#### 6.4 Order and Transaction Management
WHEN administrators process orders, THE system SHALL provide comprehensive order management tools with advanced processing capabilities.

**Order Management Features:**
- Order processing workflows with status tracking and updates
- Payment processing and refund management with audit trails
- Shipping integration with carrier APIs and tracking number generation
- Return merchandise authorization with restocking and refund processing
- Order reporting and analytics with export capabilities

#### 6.5 System Configuration and Settings
WHEN administrators configure the platform, THE system SHALL provide flexible configuration options for business customization and operational parameters.

**Configuration Management:**

- Shipping method configuration with carrier integration and rate management
- Email template management with personalization and automation rules
- User role and permission management with granular access controls

### 7. Customer Support System

#### 7.1 Customer Support Portal
WHEN customers need assistance, THE system SHALL provide multiple support channels accessible through the customer portal.

**Support Channel Requirements:**

- Live chat integration with automated chatbot for basic inquiries
- Support ticket system with category classification and priority routing
- Email support with automated acknowledgment and status updates

#### 7.2 Support Ticket Management
WHEN customers submit support requests, THE system SHALL route tickets to appropriate support agents and track resolution progress.

**Ticket Management Features:**

#### 7.3 Knowledge Base and Help Center

### 8. Analytics and Reporting System

- Mobile-specific search functionality with voice search integration

#### 9.2 Mobile-Specific Features

**Mobile Feature Requirements:**
- Mobile wallet integration including Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Samsung Pay
- Location-based services for store pickup and local delivery options
- Camera integration for barcode scanning and product research

#### 10.1 Product Search Functionality

**Search Functionality Requirements:**

- Auto-complete and suggestion features with typo tolerance

#### 10.2 Advanced Search and Filtering

**Advanced Search Features:**

#### 10.3 Product Recommendations and Personalization

**Recommendation Engine Requirements:**

- Hybrid recommendation algorithms combining multiple data sources

#### 11.1 Data Protection and Privacy

**Data Protection Requirements:**
- GDPR compliance with explicit consent management and data portability
- PCI DSS compliance for payment data handling with tokenization
- Data encryption at rest and in transit using industry-standard algorithms

#### 11.2 Authentication and Authorization Security
WHEN users access the platform, THE system SHALL implement robust authentication and authorization mechanisms to prevent unauthorized access.

**Security Measures:**

- Role-based access control with granular permission management
- Session management with secure tokens and automatic expiration
- Suspicious activity detection with automated account locking

#### 11.3 Payment Security and Compliance

**Payment Security Requirements:**

- Tokenization of payment information to minimize data exposure

- 3D Secure authentication for enhanced cardholder verification

### 12. Integration Requirements

#### 12.1 Payment Gateway Integrations

**Payment Integration Requirements:**

- Code review process with peer review requirements and automated checking
- Release management process with staging and production deployment procedures
- User feedback collection and analysis for continuous improvement
- Quality metrics tracking including defect rates, customer satisfaction, and system reliability

### 14. Technical Architecture and Infrastructure

#### 14.1 Frontend Technology Requirements

**Frontend Technology Stack:**
- React.js framework for component-based UI development with server-side rendering
- TypeScript for type-safe development with improved code maintainability
- Modern CSS frameworks including Tailwind CSS for responsive design
- Progressive Web App (PWA) capabilities for offline functionality
- Web performance optimization with lazy loading, code splitting, and caching strategies

#### 14.2 Backend Technology Requirements
WHEN server-side functionality is implemented, THE system SHALL use robust backend technologies that support scalability and maintainability.

**Backend Technology Stack:**
- Node.js with NestJS framework for scalable server-side application development
- TypeScript for full-stack type safety and improved development experience
- PostgreSQL database with advanced indexing and query optimization
- Redis for session management, caching, and real-time data operations
- Microservices architecture with containerization using Docker and Kubernetes

#### 14.3 Cloud Infrastructure and Deployment
WHEN the system is deployed, THE system SHALL use cloud infrastructure that provides scalability, reliability, and cost-effectiveness.

**Infrastructure Requirements:**
- Cloud hosting on AWS, Google Cloud Platform, or Microsoft Azure
- Auto-scaling capabilities based on traffic patterns and resource utilization

- Monitoring and logging infrastructure with automated alerting and incident response

### 15. Performance and Scalability Requirements

#### 15.1 System Performance Standards

**Performance Benchmarks:**
- Page load times under 3 seconds for all primary pages and workflows
- API response times under 500 milliseconds for 95% of requests
- Database query response times under 100 milliseconds for standard operations
- Image loading optimization with progressive enhancement and lazy loading
- Browser caching strategies for improved repeat visit performance

#### 15.2 Scalability and Capacity Planning
WHEN the platform grows, THE system SHALL scale efficiently to handle increased traffic and transaction volumes.

**Scalability Requirements:**
- Horizontal scaling capability with load balancing across multiple servers
- Database scaling with read replicas and sharding strategies for large datasets
- Caching layers to reduce database load and improve response times
- CDN integration for static content distribution and global performance

### 16. Project Timeline and Implementation Plan

#### 16.1 Development Phases and Milestones
WHEN the project is implemented, THE system SHALL be developed through structured phases with defined deliverables and testing milestones.

**Development Phases:**

- **Phase 2 (Weeks 5-8)**: User account management, order processing, and inventory management systems
- **Phase 3 (Weeks 9-12)**: Administrative panel, customer support features, and analytics dashboard
- **Phase 4 (Weeks 13-16)**: Advanced features including recommendations, mobile optimization, and third-party integrations

#### 16.2 Quality Assurance and Testing Timeline
WHEN quality standards are established, THE system SHALL undergo testing throughout development with dedicated QA phases.

**Testing Schedule:**
- **Continuous Testing**: Unit and integration testing throughout development phases
- **System Testing (Weeks 15-16)**: Comprehensive end-to-end testing and performance validation
- **User Acceptance Testing (Weeks 17-18)**: Customer feedback integration and workflow validation
- **Security Testing (Weeks 18-19)**: Penetration testing, vulnerability assessment, and compliance verification
- **Production Testing (Week 20)**: Load testing, failover testing, and production environment validation

### 17. Team Structure and Responsibilities

#### 17.1 Development Team Roles
WHEN the project is staffed, THE system SHALL be developed by a specialized team with defined roles and clear accountability.

**Team Structure:**

- **Technical Lead**: Architecture decisions, code review, and technical direction
- **Frontend Developers (2-3)**: User interface development, responsive design, and client-side functionality
- **Backend Developers (2-3)**: Server-side development, database design, and API integration
- **QA Engineers (2)**: Test planning, automation development, and quality assurance
- **DevOps Engineer**: Infrastructure setup, deployment automation, and monitoring

#### 17.2 Responsibilities and Accountability
WHEN team members are assigned tasks, THE system SHALL have clear responsibility matrices that ensure accountability and efficient collaboration.

**Key Responsibilities:**
- **Frontend Development**: User interface implementation, responsive design, performance optimization
- **Backend Development**: API development, database design, business logic implementation
- **Quality Assurance**: Test planning, automated testing, bug tracking, and release validation
- **DevOps Operations**: Infrastructure management, deployment automation, monitoring, and security
- **Project Management**: Timeline tracking, resource allocation, risk management, and stakeholder communication

## Success Criteria and Acceptance Testing

### Functional Requirements Validation
WHEN the platform is delivered, ALL functional requirements SHALL be validated through comprehensive testing scenarios that demonstrate complete system functionality.

**Acceptance Testing Criteria:**
- All user workflows complete successfully without errors or dead ends
- Performance benchmarks met under realistic load conditions
- Security requirements validated through penetration testing and compliance audits
- Mobile responsiveness verified across major devices and screen sizes
- Integration points tested with third-party services for reliability and data accuracy

### Business Process Validation
WHEN business processes are implemented, THE system SHALL demonstrate complete support for all defined business workflows and operational requirements.

**Business Validation Requirements:**
- End-to-end order processing from product selection to delivery confirmation
- Inventory management accuracy across multiple locations and sales channels
- Customer support workflows with ticket routing and resolution tracking
- Administrative functions with proper access controls and audit trails
- Analytics accuracy with verified calculations and data integrity

### Performance and Reliability Validation
WHEN performance standards are defined, THE system SHALL meet all benchmarks and maintain reliability under various load conditions.

**Performance Validation Criteria:**
- System response times within defined benchmarks under normal and peak load conditions
- Uptime and availability targets met with proper monitoring and alerting
- Scalability demonstrated through load testing and capacity planning validation
- Security measures tested and validated through comprehensive security audits
- Disaster recovery procedures tested and documented for operational readiness

This comprehensive requirements specification serves as the definitive guide for developing the E-Commerce Shopping Mall Platform, ensuring all business needs are met while maintaining high standards for performance, security, and user experience.

# E-Commerce Shopping Mall Platform - Comprehensive Requirements Specification

## Service Overview

The E-Commerce Shopping Mall Platform is a comprehensive, scalable, and secure online marketplace that enables businesses to sell products and services to customers worldwide. The platform provides complete end-to-end e-commerce functionality including product management, shopping cart operations, secure payment processing, order fulfillment, customer management, and administrative controls.

**WHEN** customers access the platform, **THE** system SHALL provide intuitive product discovery, seamless shopping experience, secure checkout process, and reliable order management while maintaining high performance standards and regulatory compliance.

## 1. System Security and Compliance Requirements

### 1.1 Security Framework and Controls

**THE** e-commerce platform SHALL implement comprehensive security controls protecting customer data, payment information, and business operations:

**SECURITY ARCHITECTURE REQUIREMENTS:**
- Multi-layered security architecture with defense-in-depth controls
- End-to-end encryption for all customer data using AES-256 encryption
- TLS 1.3 for all data in transit communication
- Role-based access control (RBAC) with principle of least privilege
- Comprehensive audit logging for all system activities

**WHEN** any customer data is processed, **THE** system SHALL encrypt data at rest using AES-256 with secure key management, ensuring encryption keys are stored separately from encrypted data.

**THE** platform SHALL implement continuous security monitoring with automated threat detection, intrusion prevention systems, and real-time security alerts for suspicious activities.

### 1.2 PCI DSS Compliance Framework

**THE** e-commerce platform SHALL maintain PCI DSS Level 1 compliance for all payment processing:

**PAYMENT SECURITY REQUIREMENTS:**
- Tokenization of all payment card information preventing raw card data storage
- PCI DSS compliant payment gateways with no cardholder data passing through merchant servers
- Network segmentation isolating payment processing systems from other platform components
- Quarterly network security scans and annual PCI compliance assessments

**WHEN** customers enter payment information, **THE** system SHALL immediately redirect to PCI-compliant payment processors and tokenize payment data for secure storage.

**PAYMENT** card data SHALL be encrypted with AES-256 encryption, and decryption keys SHALL be stored in secure key management systems with proper access controls.

### 1.3 GDPR and Privacy Compliance

**THE** platform SHALL implement comprehensive GDPR compliance with automated privacy protection:

**CUSTOMER PRIVACY RIGHTS:**
- Right to access personal data within 30 days of request
- Right to rectification of inaccurate data within 30 days
- Right to erasure (right to be forgotten) within 30 days of request
- Right to restrict processing and data portability
- Right to object to direct marketing communications

**DATA PROCESSING REQUIREMENTS:**
- Data minimization collecting only necessary information
- Privacy-by-design implementation for all new features
- Clear privacy notices with consent management
- Automated data retention and secure deletion policies

**WHEN** customers request data deletion, **THE** system SHALL permanently remove all personal data from production and backup systems within 90 days while maintaining legal compliance records.

### 1.4 Authentication and Authorization Security

**THE** platform SHALL implement multi-factor authentication (MFA) for administrative and customer security:

**AUTHENTICATION REQUIREMENTS:**
- Optional MFA for customer accounts using TOTP, SMS, or authenticator apps
- Mandatory MFA for all administrative access
- Secure session management with automatic timeout (30 minutes for customers, 15 minutes for admins)
- Session fixation protection with secure session token generation
- Maximum 3 concurrent sessions per customer account

**AUTHORIZATION FRAMEWORK:**
- Customer accounts: Browse products, manage profiles, place orders, track deliveries
- Admin accounts: Manage catalog, process orders, access customer data, generate reports
- Support accounts: View profiles, modify orders, manage communications

**WHEN** users authenticate, **THE** system SHALL regenerate session IDs after login and monitor for suspicious login patterns or geographic anomalies.

## 2. Performance and Scalability Requirements

### 2.1 System Performance Specifications

**THE** e-commerce platform SHALL maintain exceptional performance under varying load conditions:

**RESPONSE TIME REQUIREMENTS:**
- Product page load times: Maximum 2 seconds for 95th percentile
- Shopping cart operations: Maximum 1 second for 95th percentile
- Checkout process completion: Maximum 5 seconds for 95th percentile
- Search results display: Maximum 1.5 seconds for 95th percentile
- Admin dashboard load times: Maximum 3 seconds for 95th percentile

**WHEN** system load increases, **THE** platform SHALL automatically scale resources to maintain performance standards while ensuring cost efficiency through horizontal scaling.

**THROUGHPUT REQUIREMENTS:**
- Support 10,000 concurrent users without performance degradation
- Process 1,000 transactions per minute during peak periods
- Handle 100,000 product catalog queries per minute
- Support 50,000 simultaneous search operations

### 2.2 Scalability Architecture

**THE** platform SHALL implement elastic scalability with cloud-native architecture:

**SCALABILITY FEATURES:**
- Auto-scaling based on CPU, memory, and request metrics
- Horizontal scaling for web servers and API services
- Database read replicas for improved query performance
- Content Delivery Network (CDN) for static asset distribution
- Load balancing across multiple application instances

**WHEN** traffic patterns change, **THE** system SHALL automatically adjust resource allocation within 2 minutes, adding or removing instances as needed while maintaining data consistency and availability.

**CAPACITY PLANNING:**
- Support 500% growth in user base without architecture changes
- Database capacity for 10 million products and 50 million customers
- Storage capacity for 100TB of product images and documents
- Bandwidth capacity for 1TB/hour during peak traffic periods

### 2.3 System Availability and Reliability

**THE** e-commerce platform SHALL provide high availability and fault tolerance:

**AVAILABILITY REQUIREMENTS:**
- 99.9% uptime SLA (maximum 8.77 hours downtime per year)
- Zero-downtime deployments using blue-green deployment strategies
- Automatic failover to backup systems within 30 seconds
- Database replication with automatic failover capabilities
- Health monitoring with automatic instance replacement

**RELIABILITY FEATURES:**
- Circuit breaker patterns preventing cascade failures
- Retry logic with exponential backoff for external service calls
- Graceful degradation during partial system failures
- Data backup and recovery with point-in-time recovery
- Disaster recovery procedures with 4-hour recovery time objective

**WHEN** system components fail, **THE** platform SHALL automatically redirect traffic to healthy instances, maintain data integrity, and notify administrators of service degradation.

## 3. Third-Party Integrations and APIs

### 3.1 Payment Gateway Integrations

**THE** e-commerce platform SHALL integrate with multiple payment providers for enhanced reliability and customer choice:

**REQUIRED PAYMENT INTEGRATIONS:**
- Stripe: Credit card processing, Apple Pay, Google Pay
- PayPal: Express checkout, PayPal account payments
- Square: In-person and online payment processing
- Authorize.Net: Credit card and ACH processing
- Braintree: Payment processing with advanced fraud detection

**PAYMENT INTEGRATION FEATURES:**
- Real-time payment processing with immediate confirmation
- Automatic payment method tokenization for future purchases
- Support for multiple currencies (USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD)
- Payment method expiration handling and updates
- Automatic recurring billing for subscription products

**WHEN** customers select payment methods, **THE** system SHALL validate payment method availability, process transactions securely, and update order status in real-time.

### 3.2 Shipping and Logistics Integrations

**THE** platform SHALL integrate with major shipping carriers for comprehensive fulfillment:

**REQUIRED SHIPPING INTEGRATIONS:**
- UPS: Ground, Express, and International shipping services
- FedEx: SameDay, Express, and Ground delivery options
- USPS: Priority Mail, Express Mail, and Parcel Select
- DHL: International express shipping services
- Regional carriers: Local delivery and specialty shipping

**SHIPPING INTEGRATION FEATURES:**
- Real-time shipping rate calculations and comparison
- Automated shipping label generation and tracking number assignment
- Delivery confirmation and signature verification
- International shipping with customs documentation
- Returns and exchanges with prepaid shipping labels

**WHEN** orders are ready for shipment, **THE** system SHALL automatically generate shipping labels, notify customers of tracking information, and update order status throughout the fulfillment process.

### 3.3 Email and Communication Services

**THE** platform SHALL integrate with email and messaging services for customer communication:

**REQUIRED COMMUNICATION INTEGRATIONS:**
- SendGrid: Transactional and marketing email delivery
- Mailchimp: Email marketing automation and segmentation
- Twilio: SMS notifications and two-factor authentication
- Slack: Internal team notifications and alerts
- Twilio Video: Customer support video consultations

**COMMUNICATION FEATURES:**
- Automated order confirmation and shipping notifications
- Password reset and account verification emails
- Marketing campaign automation with customer segmentation
- SMS notifications for order updates and promotions
- In-app messaging for customer support interactions

**WHEN** order status changes or important events occur, **THE** system SHALL automatically send appropriate notifications through the most effective communication channels.

### 3.4 Analytics and Marketing Integrations

**THE** platform SHALL integrate with analytics and marketing tools for business intelligence:

**REQUIRED ANALYTICS INTEGRATIONS:**
- Google Analytics: Website traffic and conversion tracking
- Facebook Pixel: Social media advertising and retargeting
- Hotjar: User behavior analytics and heat mapping
- Mixpanel: Event tracking and user journey analysis
- Segment: Customer data platform and data routing

**MARKETING INTEGRATION FEATURES:**
- Customer segmentation based on purchase history and behavior
- Automated abandoned cart recovery campaigns
- Product recommendation engines using machine learning
- A/B testing for promotional campaigns and pricing strategies
- Customer lifetime value tracking and analysis

**WHEN** customers interact with the platform, **THE** system SHALL track relevant events, update customer profiles, and trigger appropriate marketing automation workflows.

## 4. Technical Architecture and Specifications

### 4.1 Backend Technology Stack

**THE** e-commerce platform SHALL use modern, scalable technology stack optimized for performance and maintainability:

**CORE TECHNOLOGIES:**
- **Backend Framework**: NestJS with TypeScript for robust, scalable API development
- **Database**: PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM for type-safe database operations
- **Caching**: Redis for session storage, caching, and real-time data
- **Message Queue**: RabbitMQ for asynchronous task processing
- **Search Engine**: Elasticsearch for advanced product search and filtering
- **File Storage**: AWS S3 or equivalent for product images and documents

**ARCHITECTURE PATTERNS:**
- Microservices architecture with domain-driven design
- Event-driven architecture for loose coupling between services
- RESTful APIs with OpenAPI/Swagger documentation
- GraphQL for complex data queries and real-time updates
- Command Query Responsibility Segregation (CQRS) for performance optimization

**WHEN** system components are developed, **THE** codebase SHALL follow established patterns, maintain type safety throughout, and include comprehensive test coverage.

### 4.2 Database Architecture and Data Management

**THE** platform SHALL implement robust database design supporting scalability and data integrity:

**DATABASE DESIGN REQUIREMENTS:**
- Normalized database schema with appropriate indexing for performance
- Foreign key constraints ensuring referential integrity
- Database migrations managed through version control
- Automated backup procedures with point-in-time recovery
- Database performance monitoring and query optimization

**DATA ARCHITECTURE:**
- **Products**: SKU, descriptions, pricing, inventory, categories, images
- **Customers**: Profiles, addresses, payment methods, order history
- **Orders**: Order details, status tracking, payment information, shipping
- **Admin**: User management, system configuration, analytics data

**WHEN** data is stored or retrieved, **THE** database SHALL maintain ACID properties, implement proper transaction management, and optimize queries for performance.

### 4.3 Security Implementation and Data Protection

**THE** platform SHALL implement comprehensive security measures throughout the application:

**APPLICATION SECURITY:**
- Input validation and sanitization for all user inputs
- SQL injection prevention through parameterized queries
- Cross-site scripting (XSS) protection with content security policies
- Cross-site request forgery (CSRF) protection using tokens
- Rate limiting and DDoS protection for API endpoints

**DATA PROTECTION:**
- Encryption at rest using AES-256 for sensitive data
- Secure key management with regular key rotation
- Personal data anonymization for analytics and reporting
- Secure data transmission using TLS 1.3
- Compliance with data residency requirements

**WHEN** security events are detected, **THE** system SHALL automatically block suspicious activities, notify security teams, and maintain detailed audit logs for investigation.

### 4.4 Monitoring and Observability

**THE** platform SHALL implement comprehensive monitoring and alerting systems:

**MONITORING REQUIREMENTS:**
- Application Performance Monitoring (APM) with distributed tracing
- Infrastructure monitoring for server health and resource utilization
- Database performance monitoring with slow query detection
- Real-user monitoring for actual customer experience tracking
- Error tracking and exception monitoring with automated alerting

**ALERTING SYSTEM:**
- Real-time alerts for system outages and performance degradation
- Threshold-based alerts for resource utilization and error rates
- Business metric alerts for conversion rate and revenue changes
- Security incident alerts for suspicious activities
- Automated escalation procedures for critical issues

**WHEN** monitoring thresholds are exceeded, **THE** system SHALL immediately alert appropriate teams, provide detailed diagnostic information, and trigger automated remediation procedures when possible.

## 5. Business Process Requirements

### 5.1 Product Management Workflow

**THE** platform SHALL provide comprehensive product management capabilities:

**PRODUCT LIFECYCLE MANAGEMENT:**
- Product creation with comprehensive information capture
- Category and tag management for product organization
- Inventory tracking with low-stock alerts and automatic reordering
- Product variations (size, color, material) with individual SKUs
- Product lifecycle status (active, discontinued, seasonal)

**PRODUCT CONTENT MANAGEMENT:**
- Rich product descriptions with formatting and media
- Multiple product images with zoom and 360-degree views
- Product specifications and technical details
- SEO-optimized content for search engine visibility
- Bulk product import/export capabilities

**WHEN** new products are added, **THE** system SHALL validate product information, generate unique SKUs, index products for search, and update inventory tracking systems.

### 5.2 Order Processing and Fulfillment

**THE** platform SHALL implement complete order management from placement to delivery:

**ORDER PROCESSING WORKFLOW:**
- Order validation with inventory and payment verification
- Order status tracking with real-time updates
- Automated order routing based on inventory location
- Batch processing for high-volume order periods
- Order modification and cancellation capabilities

**FULFILLMENT OPERATIONS:**
- Pick list generation for warehouse operations
- Shipping label creation and carrier integration
- Delivery tracking with customer notifications
- Returns and exchange processing with automated workflows
- Refund processing with payment gateway integration

**WHEN** orders are placed, **THE** system SHALL validate inventory, process payments, generate fulfillment instructions, and provide customers with real-time order tracking.

### 5.3 Customer Experience and Support

**THE** platform SHALL deliver exceptional customer experience throughout the shopping journey:

**CUSTOMER INTERFACE REQUIREMENTS:**
- Intuitive product search with filters and sorting options
- Personalized product recommendations based on browsing history
- Shopping cart persistence across devices and sessions
- Guest checkout with account creation incentives
- Mobile-responsive design for all device types

**CUSTOMER SUPPORT FEATURES:**
- Multi-channel support (chat, email, phone, social media)
- Knowledge base with searchable help articles
- Ticket tracking system with escalation procedures
- Live chat with automated chatbots for common queries
- Customer feedback collection and analysis

**WHEN** customers need assistance, **THE** system SHALL provide immediate access to support resources, route inquiries to appropriate teams, and track resolution times for continuous improvement.

### 5.4 Administrative Operations and Management

**THE** platform SHALL provide comprehensive administrative controls for business operations:

**ADMINISTRATIVE DASHBOARD:**
- Real-time business metrics and key performance indicators
- Sales analytics with trend analysis and forecasting
- Customer analytics with segmentation and behavior analysis
- Inventory management with stock level monitoring
- System health monitoring with performance metrics

**BUSINESS MANAGEMENT:**
- User role and permission management
- Promotional campaign creation and management
- Pricing and discount rule configuration
- System configuration and integration management
- Audit trail maintenance for compliance reporting

**WHEN** administrative actions are performed, **THE** system SHALL validate permissions, log all activities for audit purposes, and provide confirmation of successful completion.

## 6. Integration and API Requirements

### 6.1 External Service Integration Standards

**THE** platform SHALL integrate with external services using industry-standard protocols:

**API INTEGRATION REQUIREMENTS:**
- RESTful APIs with JSON data exchange
- OAuth 2.0 for secure third-party authentication
- Webhook support for real-time event notifications
- API rate limiting and usage monitoring
- Comprehensive error handling and retry mechanisms

**INTEGRATION SECURITY:**
- API key management with regular rotation schedules
- Request signing for high-risk operations
- IP whitelisting for sensitive integrations
- Data encryption for all external communications
- Compliance verification for payment and shipping providers

**WHEN** external integrations are configured, **THE** system SHALL establish secure connections, validate service availability, and monitor integration performance continuously.

### 6.2 Data Synchronization and ETL Requirements

**THE** platform SHALL maintain data consistency across all integrated systems:

**DATA SYNCHRONIZATION:**
- Real-time data sync for critical business information
- Batch processing for non-critical data updates
- Conflict resolution strategies for data inconsistencies
- Data validation and quality assurance checks
- Automated retry mechanisms for failed synchronizations

**ETL PROCESSES:**
- Extract-transform-load pipelines for data integration
- Data mapping and transformation rules
- Error handling and logging for failed ETL operations
- Performance optimization for large-scale data processing
- Data lineage tracking for compliance reporting

**WHEN** data synchronization is required, **THE** system SHALL maintain data integrity, handle conflicts gracefully, and provide comprehensive logging for troubleshooting.

## 7. Compliance and Regulatory Requirements

### 7.1 Industry-Specific Compliance

**THE** e-commerce platform SHALL maintain compliance with relevant industry regulations:

**PAYMENT COMPLIANCE:**
- PCI DSS Level 1 compliance for card processing
- SOX compliance for financial reporting and controls
- Anti-money laundering (AML) requirements for financial transactions
- Know Your Customer (KYC) procedures for high-value transactions
- Credit card surcharge and fee disclosure requirements

**PRODUCT COMPLIANCE:**
- Product safety regulations and standards compliance
- Import/export regulations for international sales
- Tax compliance including VAT and sales tax calculations
- Environmental regulations for packaging and shipping
- Industry-specific regulations (electronics, food, pharmaceuticals)

**WHEN** regulatory requirements change, **THE** system SHALL automatically update compliance procedures, notify affected stakeholders, and maintain documentation of compliance status.

### 7.2 International Trade and Shipping Compliance

**THE** platform SHALL support international commerce with proper regulatory compliance:

**INTERNATIONAL COMPLIANCE:**
- Customs documentation and declaration requirements
- Export control regulations and restricted country compliance
- International shipping regulations and carrier requirements
- Currency conversion and international payment processing
- Cross-border tax compliance and reporting

**TRADE COMPLIANCE:**
- Trade agreement compliance (USMCA, EU trade agreements)
- Sanctions screening and restricted party lists
- Export license requirements for controlled goods
- Import duties and tariff calculations
- International return and warranty procedures

**WHEN** international orders are processed, **THE** system SHALL automatically generate required customs documentation, calculate appropriate duties and taxes, and ensure compliance with trade regulations.

## 8. Success Metrics and Performance Indicators

### 8.1 Business Performance Metrics

**THE** platform SHALL track and report comprehensive business performance indicators:

**REVENUE METRICS:**
- Gross merchandise value (GMV) and net revenue tracking
- Average order value (AOV) with trend analysis
- Customer lifetime value (CLV) calculation and optimization
- Revenue per visitor (RPV) and conversion rate monitoring
- Seasonal and promotional campaign performance analysis

**CUSTOMER METRICS:**
- Customer acquisition cost (CAC) and retention rates
- Customer satisfaction scores and Net Promoter Score (NPS)
- Customer support ticket resolution times
- Return and refund rates with cause analysis
- Customer engagement metrics (time on site, pages per session)

**OPERATIONAL METRICS:**
- Order fulfillment times and accuracy rates
- Inventory turnover and stock-out frequency
- Shipping performance and delivery success rates
- System uptime and performance metrics
- Security incident frequency and resolution times

### 8.2 Technical Performance Indicators

**THE** platform SHALL monitor and optimize technical performance continuously:

**PERFORMANCE MONITORING:**
- Page load times and server response times
- Database query performance and optimization opportunities
- API response times and error rates
- Search performance and relevance metrics
- Mobile performance and responsive design effectiveness

**RELIABILITY METRICS:**
- System availability and downtime tracking
- Error rates and exception frequency
- Recovery time objectives (RTO) and recovery point objectives (RPO)
- Backup and disaster recovery testing results
- Security incident response times and resolution rates

**WHEN** performance metrics indicate issues or opportunities, **THE** system SHALL automatically generate alerts, provide detailed diagnostic information, and support data-driven optimization decisions.

## 9. Implementation and Deployment Requirements

### 9.1 Development and Deployment Pipeline

**THE** platform SHALL implement modern DevOps practices for reliable deployment:

**DEVELOPMENT STANDARDS:**
- Automated testing with unit, integration, and end-to-end test suites
- Code quality analysis with static code analysis and security scanning
- Version control with Git and feature branch workflows
- Code review processes with automated approval workflows
- Documentation generation from code annotations and comments

**DEPLOYMENT AUTOMATION:**
- Continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines
- Automated deployment to staging and production environments
- Blue-green deployment for zero-downtime deployments
- Automated rollback capabilities for failed deployments
- Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with Terraform or CloudFormation

**WHEN** code changes are committed, **THE** system SHALL automatically run tests, perform security scans, and deploy to appropriate environments following established approval processes.

### 9.2 Quality Assurance and Testing

**THE** platform SHALL implement comprehensive testing strategies ensuring reliability:

**TESTING REQUIREMENTS:**
- Unit tests achieving minimum 90% code coverage
- Integration tests for all API endpoints and database operations
- End-to-end tests for critical user journeys and business processes
- Performance testing simulating realistic user loads
- Security testing including penetration testing and vulnerability assessments

**TEST AUTOMATION:**
- Automated test execution in CI/CD pipelines
- Test data management with realistic and anonymized data sets
- Cross-browser and cross-device testing for compatibility
- Automated visual regression testing for UI consistency
- Load testing with realistic traffic patterns and peak loads

**WHEN** tests are executed, **THE** system SHALL generate detailed reports, identify failing tests automatically, and prevent deployment of code that doesn't meet quality standards.

## Conclusion

This comprehensive requirements specification defines the foundation for building a world-class e-commerce shopping mall platform that delivers exceptional customer experiences while maintaining the highest standards of security, performance, and compliance. The platform will leverage modern technology stack, scalable architecture, and comprehensive integration capabilities to support business growth and operational excellence.

**THE** implementation of these requirements SHALL create a robust, secure, and scalable e-commerce platform capable of supporting businesses of all sizes while providing customers with seamless shopping experiences across all channels and devices.

**FUTURE** enhancements and adaptations to these requirements SHALL be guided by customer feedback, market trends, and technological innovations, ensuring the platform continues to meet evolving business needs and customer expectations.
